agents.purpose: Extract concepts, claims, questions, entities, and candidate relationships from approved sources.
Normalize names, aliases, types, and relationship labels.
Detect likely duplicate concepts and prepare merge candidates without auto-merging canonical records.
Create draft graph nodes and edges from validated extraction output.
Detect isolated concepts, weak links, missing dependencies, and incomplete coverage.
Generate and rank questions that connect disconnected concept clusters.
Verify that every material concept and relationship has traceable evidence.
Identify conflicting claims and impacted workflows without silently resolving them.
Apply lifecycle, approval, compliance, and canonical-promotion rules.
Produce technical, executive, study, and operational graph reports.
